# Keep Some MORE Inventory

This is an newer version of [Keep Some Inventory by PuckiSilver](https://modrinth.com/mod/keep-some-inventory) updated to be compatible with 26.2

I tried using Claude code for the first time to help me find the incompatiblities since I've got no clue what I'm doing so that helped. Don't worry, It only advised me.
